text.tspan: Deleting a pod: two things start at the same moment (the race)
Fix the race: a short preStop sleep (routing updates before SIGTERM) + an app that handles SIGTERM
+ readiness probes + maxUnavailable: 0. Kubernetes waits 30 s by default; docker stop waits 10 s.
